purpose: Teach: メタデータ/主眼/採る/価額/常設/工学科/多面/製作所

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様データのメタデータ管理を強化しましょう
lines.en: We should strengthen our customer data metadata management.
lines.style: Crisp, authoritative opening. Measured pace with forward momentum. Professional but not cold—the tone of someone who's thought this through. Clear enunciation on the key term.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗運営の主眼を清潔さに置きます
lines.en: Yes. We'll make cleanliness the cornerstone of the new store operations.
lines.style: Affirming and engaged. Slightly quicker tempo than the previous line—eager to show he's already aligned. Warm undertone of reliability. The 'yes' lands with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 優秀な人材を業界から採るチャンスです
lines.en: This is our chance to recruit top talent from the industry.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured delivery with subtle emphasis on 'chance'—this is an opportunity, not routine. Voice carries quiet conviction. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仕入れの価額を見直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed our purchasing costs.
lines.style: Direct and efficient. Quick affirmation, then matter-of-fact statement of completed action. No flourish—this is concrete progress. Steady eye-contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店内に常設の展示棚を作りましょう
lines.en: Let's install permanent display shelving in the store.
lines.style: Clear directive with embedded reasoning. Moderate pace, assured. The tone of someone issuing a plan they've already visualized. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工学科出身の社員から技術アイデアを集めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll gather technical ideas from our engineering-trained staff.
lines.style: Responsive and specific. 'Yes' lands lightly, then momentum picks up on the concrete action. Shows he's already thinking through execution. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の声を多面的に分析しましょう
lines.en: We should analyze customer feedback from multiple angles.
lines.style: Strategic and inclusive. 'We' carries weight—this is collaborative thinking. Deliberate pace. The voice of someone mapping out the next phase. Slight emphasis on 'multiple.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社直営の製作所運営も検討します
lines.en: Yes. We should also consider managing our own manufacturing facility under headquarters oversight.
lines.style: Final affirmation with expanded scope. Tempo slightly slower—this is a bigger idea, one he's presenting as a natural next step. Confident closure. The period lands firmly.
